title: Solo dev, round two: my last post went negative, so I brought better guns
author: Ditex_Design
selftext:
My first big post about this game ended with a negative score. Fair enough. If you'd seen the guns back then, you'd have downvoted too.

I'm a solo dev building BLOCKRIFT, a fast arena FPS that runs in the browser with no download. The guns have gone through three versions:

**V1, box guns.** Every weapon was the same handful of boxes built in code, just with different sizes. A sniper was a longer rifle with a tube on top. This is the era that earned the downvotes.

**V2, voxel pack.** Real shapes, built cube by cube, up to 36 cubes a gun and four flat colours. Better, but still not upvote material.

**V3, RIFT armory.** 12 new guns with proper models and textures: assault rifles, SMGs, shotguns, snipers, a revolver, an LMG and a minigun.

The video shows the same rifle in all three versions, then the full new set.

replies.body: how you make model doing such details - does it using any references such as papers or images ?

replies.author: Ditex_Design
replies.body: I am preparing little process how they were made ill upload ASAP, I used code for v1, for v2 blockbench and for v3 meshy + astra image generation + blender/higgsfield and then output.

comments.author: hyperg8_games
comments.body: jump from V1 to V3 sounds like a big upgrade, but with a name like BLOCKRIFT I would double check the textured guns still fit a blocky world, maybe the V2 voxel look was closer to your identity than you think. And from my experience (I posted here about my own dream project flopping on CrazyGames), platform fit hurt me way more than polish did, web portal players are mostly young and casual, so I would check if a fast arena FPS actually does well on the portal you target before you polish further. Which portal are you aiming for?

replies.author: Ditex_Design
replies.body:
First of all thanks for your feedback yes, I think  some times that I went on other direction rather then staying on closer to "block" with guns and still thinking that I must do something about that, I have an few ideas how it can fixed but for now its ready for first beta so I am not touching anything or I will never finish. Also about question which Portal I am aiming is also good but its different on my case, I'll explain- fast pased FPS is my aim at start but it just lvl 1 of what I have in mind on this game, I have few good Ideas which will be implemented here that will help game to be more closer to blocks and also different. My goal is to try something new and I am not afraid to experiment as long as I do some research right and prepare before each new feature. Again thanks for feedback thats helps a lot will be looking forward for more
